name: vision_parse
description: Shared PDF and image reader with native-text coverage, OCR-first raster masking, targeted repair and selective Ollama vision. Generic media scene, face, and identity analysis, catalog-independent.
capabilities: grayscale page/ink coverage threshold and image-aware vision skip
OCR-first scanned PDF and PNG/JPEG/WebP/BMP/TIFF reading
transparent high-confidence OCR text mask for localized remaining-image vision
YuNet face occurrence UUIDs and SFace embeddings
OpenCV CPU YuNet/SFace default, optional explicit ONNX CUDA
batch person-profile reconciliation with alias protection
scene categories via shared Ollama vision client
